name: UI rendering
definition: Turn application state into interactive UI.

name: Server-side rendering
definition: Render UI on the server for delivery to clients.

name: Application routing
definition: Map URLs/navigation to application views.

name: Server state management
definition: Cache/synchronize remote authoritative state on the client.

name: Client state management
definition: Manage UI-local state that is not authoritative server data.

name: Runtime validation
definition: Validate data structures at runtime.

name: Form state
definition: Manage input state, validation lifecycle and submission.

name: CSS styling
definition: Author and scope application presentation styles.

name: Accessible UI primitives
definition: Provide behaviorally correct accessible UI components.

name: Build & bundling
definition: Transform/package application source for execution.

name: Unit testing
definition: Execute isolated automated tests.

name: End-to-end testing
definition: Automate complete user/browser flows.

name: Reverse proxy
definition: Proxy, route and terminate network requests.

name: API gateway
definition: Govern, authenticate, meter and route APIs.

name: Service mesh
definition: Provide service-to-service traffic policy, security and telemetry.

name: Durable event streaming
definition: Persist ordered/replayable event streams.

name: Message broker
definition: Queue and route messages with delivery semantics.

name: Stream processing
definition: Process stateful/windowed computations over streams.

name: API contract
definition: Define machine-readable service interfaces.

name: Caching
definition: Store reusable data close to consumers to reduce latency/load.

name: Session storage
definition: Persist session/state shared across application instances.

name: Full-text search
definition: Index and retrieve text-oriented data.

name: Vector similarity search
definition: Retrieve items by embedding/vector similarity.

name: Identity provider
definition: Authenticate identities and issue identity assertions/tokens.

name: Authorization
definition: Decide whether an actor may perform an action on a resource.

name: Secret management
definition: Store and issue credentials/secrets securely.

name: Durable workflow
definition: Run long-lived failure-tolerant application workflows.

name: Data orchestration
definition: Schedule and coordinate data pipelines/DAGs.

name: Observability telemetry
definition: Capture traces, metrics and logs.

name: HTTP web API
definition: Serve request/response APIs over HTTP.

name: ORM / data access
definition: Map application data models and queries to persistent databases.

name: Background jobs
definition: Execute deferred/asynchronous work.

name: HTTP client
definition: Call remote HTTP services.

name: Native runtime capability
definition: Functionality supplied directly by the language/runtime standard platform.

name: Container deployment
definition: Package/run an application as a container.

name: Kubernetes orchestration
definition: Declare and operate container workloads on Kubernetes.

name: Serverless compute
definition: Run application functions/services on managed event-driven compute.

name: Virtual machine compute
definition: Run application workloads on VM infrastructure.
